changelog: New: tracked SQL migration runner (migrate.php) — the app can now actually deliver schema changes, not just files
schema_migrations tracking table with checksum verification, stop-on-first-failure, and status/run/baseline modes
Two self-test migrations included to prove the runner end to end (create + drop a throwaway table)
No product-facing schema changes in this release — see release notes for the three missing tables (strategies, strategy_variables, trade_variables) planned for the next release
